title: Two CTCF motifs impede cohesin-mediated DNA loop extrusion
authors: Barth R; Janissen R; Muras L; van der Torre J; Litos G; van der Sluis E; van der Graaf A; Davidson IF; Peters J; Dekker C
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单分子实验揭示CTCF NTR中两个基序以不同机制阻碍cohesin介导的DNA环挤压，虽聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制且方法为单分子实验而非AI/物理模拟，但机制发现对TF-DNA动态互作建模有重要启发。
abstract: Cohesin extrudes DNA into loops and is positioned along the genome by stalling at CTCF upon encountering its N-terminal region (NTR). The mechanism underlying this stalling, however, is unresolved. Using single-molecule assays that monitor DNA loop extrusion (LE) in the presence of NTR fragments, we identify two amino acid motifs, YDF and KTYQR, that hinder LE. KTYQR is found to fully impede LE activity, while YDF hinders cohesin to complete LE step cycles and converts cohesin into a unidirectional extruder by strengthening the affinity of STAG1 to DNA. We thus identify two distinct NTR motifs that stall LE via different yet synergistic mechanisms, highlighting the multifaceted ways employed by CTCF to modulate LE to shape and regulate genomes.
abstract_zh: 黏连蛋白（cohesin）将DNA挤压成环状结构，并在遇到CTCF的N端区域（NTR）时停滞于此，从而沿基因组定位。然而，这种停滞背后的机制尚未明确。利用在存在NTR片段时监测DNA环挤压（LE）的单分子实验，我们识别出两个氨基酸基序，YDF和KTYQR，它们阻碍LE。研究发现，KTYQR完全抑制LE活性，而YDF则阻碍黏连蛋白完成LE步进循环，并通过增强STAG1与DNA的亲和力，将黏连蛋白转变为单向挤压器。因此，我们确定了两个不同的NTR基序，它们通过不同但协同的机制使LE停滞，突显了CTCF调节LE以塑造和调控基因组的多种方式。
